## Negation Rewrite Patch

Claude tends to "acknowledge" negation but sometimes violates it.
Rephrase negative rules as affirmative alternatives:
- "Do not use emoji" → "Respond using only plain text characters"
- "Do not clean up unrelated code" → "Touch only the files directly related to the request"

## Example Addition Patch

Claude benefits from concrete examples. For critical rules, append:

```
Good: "Fixing the off-by-one on line 42." [then calls Edit tool]
Bad: "Great question! I'd be happy to help. Let me fix that for you..." [then explains instead of acting]
```

## No Structural Changes Needed

Claude handles long-form instructions well. Do not break into numbered lists
(that would waste tokens without benefit for this model).
